items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he was telling me and Jeannie Cheatham about that.

ctx.x: He went with me and picked out my first computer.
I think you had just bought it then, because he was telling me and Jeannie Cheatham about that.
I had the stroke already. I don’t know if I was talking or not then. But he got me and we went downtown and bought the computer.
